cohort: All neonates admitted to the NICU at Nippon Medical School Musashikosugi Hospital from December 2010 through November 2013
finding: The establishment of the NICU led to closer cooperation beyond the framework of a single department and provided opportunities for medical students and residents to observe and participate in multidisciplinary medical care.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was performed in 48% of the births.
